MC3 LNPs behaved similarly; less DNA was measured per cell in endothelial cells, relative to the other cell types; these results were not statistically significant (Figs. 2c and 2d). These data suggested that both cKK-E12 and MC3 distribute broadly to all 3 tested cell types within the liver.
